asr.full_text: Yogi Adityanath has decided to make Uttar Pradesh his own state. Uttar Pradesh is called Uttam Pradesh. Uttam Pradesh is a state where the law is tight, the roads are safe for women and girls, everyone gets a job, everyone gets a job. In the last ten days, Yogi has done a lot that makes it seem like Uttam Pradesh is falling apart. For Uttam Pradesh, Yogi has made 11 mantras. Now, those mantras are being passed from officials to BJP's officials and officials. We want to say that our Pradesh is down, down, down in the legal system. Akhilesh Yadav gave Yogi Adityanath in his legacy. Akhilesh Yadav and his wife Dimple Yadav had worked very hard to win the elections. But Dimple was not convinced that UP's law system is down down down. We would like to say that our country is down-down-down in the law. The daughters of UP were taken at home who feared of the ...situations by the fear of leaving the home? I would like to address the parents of Uttar Pradesh. Today in Delhi... ...there is a brother in Delhi... ...who wants to serve in Uttar Pradesh... ...to protect you from being taken by the police. Please give us a chance. What is the reason? What is the reason, my mother, my sisters, this injustice. Today there is no such place of Uttar Pradesh where, where, by day or night, a mother or a daughter can get out of their house alone. CM Yogi Adityanath, has completed already completed the first ten days to change the UP. In the center Modi and in UP Yogi has imagined such a Uttar Pradesh in which there will be the rule of law. The sisters and daughters will be protected. The Ganga of development will flow and Uttar Pradesh will become the top land. Dr. Moha Gopal Pradesh Deputy Head of General Planning Department and I am sure that this country will be a great country! In the coming two years, we will not have to face heat, rain, or other weather conditions. The weather may become hot, you might be in cold or warm. It can be or may be not, but we have to work with all the conditions. and remain equal or not. After 10 days, Adityanath, a country whose nation is the biggest, has shown his support for Uttar Pradesh. Yogis are also eager to see that in 5 years, Uttar Pradesh will be the same sort of Uttar Pradesh where everyone will have to share, what people say about the country. To make the entire country the best as well like the great Uttar Pradesh. This won't happen today. The myth that has been made of the Uttar Pradesh will end up in the darkness overnight. The way roads will break will end up in the black. The same thing'll happen to the security at Uttar Pradesh. The bigger the party, the bigger the challenge. .. and many challenges are facing them by those with the same party.. For Yogi, the biggest challenge is making your people not helpless.. this is why Yogi has called them here and has explained.. .. to us the principles of making Uttan Pradesh. I, Adityanath Yogi.. ..is doing its job. Do you know about the people here? We have not come here to have fun. We have come here to work for 18-20 hours. I'm here. It's not possible to see Uttam Pradesh in 10 days. But Yogi has started. It starts from here. If you change, the world will change. If you take care of your home, the world will change too. If You would manage the whole house than the whole world will follow suit too. To make 22 crores population of Uttar Pradesh This is the mind of a Yogi that holds their words for Uttar Pnatesh In just a week We have made few small choices but in the big decisions in favour of North India and its 22 crore people. To explain this mantra of Uttar Pradesh, Yogi Adityanath met the 300-odd BJP MPs in Lok Bhawan, LuckP for the first time. Yogi's meeting with his party's MPs was not just a chat or a breakfast. Yogi knows that the MPs who have become BJP government after 14 years of winning, if they are not under his control, the entire KIA will be ruined. The government should run well and the government's image should be good. And the government's employees should work properly. All this depends on the administrations. That's why Yogi started from his own home. He gave the title of Uttar Pradesh the best! 1st Mantra Governmental trucks and houses must not stand in front of the members. There should no discrimination! We should serve everyone this is how we live! We are ordinary people! We need to keep distance… 2nd Mantra We may not be normal but we must show common people our way, we too are common person among the public. Next, MPs must work on the job, make work accessible and do not use property. Third, MPs must lead a simple and well mannered life, a government house must not beuries out of the government money. Most important point is that the CM informed the officials that they should behave properly. And that the government officials should not take an unnecessary stand in this. Fourth point. Vidharit family would not be making not throw their ground at government officials. Fifth, the alertness and civility increase in talking to the authorities on the phone. Eighth Minister! It is to maintain the image of the Government. Ninth Minister! Never distinguish a state from another state. Tenth Minister! In order to improve, he can only face me or the minister. 11th month, the most important thing that the MLA'll have to do, is he himself will see to all those things we will do. Do you know why? To make some sort of a message of Delhi to take on the first day of the New Year's day. Do you know why that happened? But that wasn't the reason he spoke up against the government, he actually said that, he doesn't want to create a problem for these transfer bans. In U.P.Yogi has started where Modi went to back out from in the CM. Modi has tightened the transfer rule, imposed sanctions on ministers. He drew the line towards ministers. This will make a mark for 3 years. But there has been no sign of defamation at all. As Modi steps forward, there is no need of doing any other research to make Modi the government's example. The Modi for the Central Party and that Yogi, are showing the right path. UP, plus Yogi, equals UP Yogi. that without enjoying the worldly pleasures and the pleasures of years, what has changed in that bungalow? Before Yogi's immigration, the furniture with leather and mattresses were removed from 5 Kalidas Marg. The old owners of 5 Kalidas Marg bungalow, Akhilesh Yadav and Mayawati, used to work in the same building. In yogi times, the bungalow would have furniture, but only wooden furniture. This is because yogis do not sit on leather furniture. There will be wooden chairs, wooden chairs and wooden chairs to sit and sleep in the CM house. It is also being said that the bedroom of a yogi will not even have an AC. I'm here to have fun. We are here to work for 18 to 20 hours. Those who can work for 18 to 20 hours with us. They should stay hours, stay here or else prepare your way. The more we go in the stage of Baba Ram Dev's program that when Amit Shah told him to take the oath of UP CM he only had one set of clothes Amit Raj ji from the political party has told me to go to Uttara Pradesh I said I am not coming to Uttara Pradesh when he said no, you have to take the post of Chief Minister tomorrow. I will assure you that I had such clothes. Yogi is the CM of the biggest state in the country. 22 crore people state in the country. The population of 22 crores is in his care. Yogi should have been proud. But Yogi is proud. Modi has given the job of changing the future of such a great state in the hands of a patriot. BJP I see that people don't abandon the sages and saints, but my party and our Prime Minister has entrusted me with this. As a Yogi, according to the Lok Sabha, you have never fought the election of the constitution, but have measured every street of UP. When you measure the road, you are even aware of the problems. The new commissioner of state election has not lost his hold but the people of Uttar Pradesh have measured every road. When they measure the roads, then they know about their problems. There has been a constant change in the state of Uttar Pradesh since years. After 14 years BJP has been given the power and Yogi has been given the responsibility of treatment. Yogi has become obsessed with finding solutions to his problems. Sir, I am not in the state of Pune. I have travelled from road to city.
